newsitem.title: USA: Firm says to nominate two to Standard board.
newsitem.headline: Firm says to nominate two to Standard board.

text.p: LaSalle/Kross Partners LP said it notified Standard Financial Inc on Monday of its intention to nominate two persons for election as directors at the company's annual meeting in 1997.

The group said in a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission that it holds a 5.4 percent stake or 865,000 common shares of Standard, including 15,000 bought on November 26 at $19.50 a share.
The group said it holds its stake in Standard for investment.
